name: scenivia
description: Make and edit motion-design launch and feature films for SaaS products in Scenivia: brief a project, pick a Library template and write its lines, set the brand, then check and export the film.

interface.longDescription: Create launch and feature videos for your SaaS product from its website. Scenivia turns a product brief into an editable motion-design film of 15 to 45 seconds for X, LinkedIn, Product Hunt or a landing page. Create a project, set the brief and brand, pick a template from the Library and write its lines, change one scene at a time, then check and export the MP4. Cards show the project, the export progress and the templates inline. Scenivia acts with the connected account, only on the projects that account can open, and starts an export only after the person agrees.
defaultPrompt: Make a launch video for my SaaS from its website.
Which Scenivia templates fit a product launch?

positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's projects with their names and links to open them in the Studio.

positive.prompt: Which Scenivia templates fit a SaaS product launch?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows template cards with a preview, duration and number of shots, and offers to use one.

positive.description: Create a project and write the brief
positive.prompt: Create a Scenivia project for Northwind, an invoicing app for freelancers, aimed at solo founders, call to action: start free.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a project and saves a brief with the product, audience and call to action, then returns the project card.

positive.prompt: Open my most recent Scenivia project and tell me its scenes.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the project card with its scenes, duration and format, and a link to open it in the Studio.

positive.prompt: Is my latest Scenivia project ready to export?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports whether the film can be exported and any blocking issue, without starting a render.

publication.release_notes: First release: projects, briefs, templates, scene edits and exports from ChatGPT, with inline cards for projects, exports and templates.

fr-FR.subtitle: Vidéos de lancement SaaS
fr-FR.description: Créez des vidéos de lancement et de fonctionnalité pour votre produit SaaS à partir de son site. Scenivia transforme un brief produit en film de motion design modifiable : une vidéo de lancement ou de fonctionnalité de 15 à 45 secondes pour X, LinkedIn, Product Hunt ou une landing page. Créez un projet, posez le brief et la marque, choisissez un modèle de la bibliothèque et écrivez ses textes, modifiez une scène à la fois, puis vérifiez et exportez le MP4. Scenivia agit avec le compte connecté, seulement sur les projets que ce compte peut ouvrir, et ne lance un export qu'avec l'accord de la personne.
